purpose: Prevent live detached-water shader compiler failure when playback first creates blob families.
implementation: Separate Gaussian tracing and bounded scene-buffer lighting into two programs, prepared before playback. Bulk water and historical snapshots retain their existing render paths.
gpuFixture: 12 frames at 96x64 using actual live renderer shaders, one moving detached family, carved sand, rock and glass cup. No full-beach stress run.
gpuNumericalCheck: Reconstructed fragment depths agree with the CPU Gaussian isosurface reference within 0.000294 density units.
tradeoff: Detached droplets use screen-space secondary reflection/refraction and cached medium light. Off-screen reflections fall back to the sky; local light visibility is approximate.
investigation: An intermediate split retaining the large scene-lighting program lost context with objects. That program was removed from the live blob pass. The subsequent graphics-only health check and final bounded regression both passed without restarting.
